exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which picture shows: car fumes; public transport; a rainforest; a person planting a tree; a hunter; wildlife?

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SURAT - OLTI TUShUNChA.

  car fumes → 4 (tirband ko'cha)
  public transport → 2 (avtobus)
  a rainforest → 1 (o'rmon)
  a person planting a tree → 6
  a hunter → 5 (miltiq)
  wildlife → 3 (bug'ular)


⚠ 'FUMES':

  = tutun, zaharli gaz.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM ko'plikda.
  ⚠ 'car fumes' = mashina tutuni.


⚠ 'PUBLIC TRANSPORT':

  = jamoat transporti.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'WILDLIFE':

  = yovvoyi tabiat (hayvonlar).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'PRECIOUS':

  = qimmatli, aziz.
  ⚠ 'Our Precious Planet' - unit
  nomi (68-betdagi muqovada).

tasks.en: [1 Roberta - Italy] If I were leader of my country, I would ban cars because they cause too much air pollution. I hate it when I'm riding my bike in the street and I can hardly breathe because of the traffic fumes. It makes me feel really ill.
tasks.uz: [1 Roberta - Italiya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim, chunki ular juda ko'p havo ifloslanishiga sabab bo'ladi. Ko'chada velosiped haydayotganimda transport tutuni tufayli deyarli nafas ololmasligimni yomon ko'raman. Bu meni haqiqatan kasal his qildiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'If I WERE ... I WOULD ban' - 2-tur shart.
⚠ 'hardly' = deyarli ... emas.
⚠ 'because OF' + ot.

tasks.en: Air pollution causes acid rain, too, which kills trees and plants. I would also improve public transport. People wouldn't need to use their cars so much then. I think people should walk more often, or use a bicycle, like me! If they did, our cities would be healthier places to live in.
tasks.uz: Havo ifloslanishi kislotali yomg'irga ham sabab bo'ladi, u daraxt va o'simliklarni o'ldiradi. Men jamoat transportini ham yaxshilardim. Unda odamlar mashinalarini shunchalik ko'p ishlatishi kerak bo'lmasdi. Menimcha, odamlar men kabi ko'proq piyoda yurishi yoki velosiped ishlatishi kerak! Agar shunday qilsalar, shaharlarimiz yashash uchun sog'lomroq joylar bo'lardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'which kills' - nisbiy olmosh (11-unit).
⚠ 'If they DID, ... WOULD BE' - 2-tur shart.
⚠ 'healthier' = sog'lomroq.

tasks.en: [2 James - Kenya] If I were the leader of my country, I wouldn't allow hunters to kill endangered species. Did you know that animals such as tigers and rhinos have been hunted so much that there will soon be none left?
tasks.uz: [2 James - Keniya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, ovchilarga xavf ostidagi turlarni o'ldirishga ruxsat bermasdim. Yo'lbars va karkidon kabi hayvonlar shunchalik ko'p ovlanganki, tez orada birontasi ham qolmasligini bilarmidingiz?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'have been hunted' - present perfect majhul.
⚠ 'none left' = hech biri qolmagan.
⚠ 'such as' = kabi, masalan.

tasks.en: I think we need to teach hunters that it's wrong to kill these animals. I would also create special parks where these animals could live safely.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, biz ovchilarga bu hayvonlarni o'ldirish noto'g'riligini o'rgatishimiz kerak. Men bu hayvonlar xavfsiz yashashi mumkin bo'lgan maxsus parklar ham yaratardim.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'where these animals could live' - nisbiy
olmosh 'where'.
⚠ 'safely' = xavfsiz (ravish).

tasks.en: [3 Maria - Brazil] If I were the leader of my country, I would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest. It's terrible the way that animals and rare plants die when the trees disappear. Don't these companies know that they're not just destroying the trees and the wildlife? They could destroy us all!
tasks.uz: [3 Maria - Braziliya] Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, yog'och kompaniyalarini tropik o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatardim. Daraxtlar yo'qolganda hayvonlar va noyob o'simliklar o'lishi dahshatli. Bu kompaniyalar faqat daraxt va yovvoyi tabiatni emas, hammamizni vayron qilishi mumkinligini bilmaydimi?
tasks.note:
⚠ 'stop sb FROM doing' = ... dan to'xtatmoq.
⚠ 'rare' = noyob, kam uchraydigan.
⚠ "Don't these companies know ...?" - inkor
savol (hayrat).

tasks.en: Trees produce oxygen, which is one of our most basic needs. One answer to the problem is to make the logging companies plant new trees. If they did that, it could save the rainforest and give all of us cleaner air to breathe.
tasks.uz: Daraxtlar kislorod ishlab chiqaradi, bu bizning eng asosiy ehtiyojlarimizdan biri. Muammoning bir yechimi - yog'och kompaniyalarini yangi daraxt ekishga majburlash. Agar shunday qilsalar, bu tropik o'rmonni saqlab qolishi va hammamizga nafas olish uchun tozaroq havo berishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'oxygen' /ˈɒksɪdʒən/ = kislorod.
⚠ 'basic needs' = asosiy ehtiyojlar.
⚠ 'make sb do' - 'to' siz.
⚠ 'to breathe' /briːð/ = nafas olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Water, Water Everywhere ...
exercises.instructionUz: Suv, hamma yerda suv ...
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Ichimlik suvi bo'lmagan, yuvinish
va ovqat pishirish uchun suv bo'lmagan
dunyoni tasavvur qiling. Buni
tasavvur qilish qiyin, chunki biz
suvni har kuni hatto o'ylamasdan
ishlatamiz. Lekin butun dunyoda
dahshatli suv tanqisligi bor.
Masalan, Afrika va Xitoyning ba'zi
qismlarida ko'p odamlarda hatto
ichish uchun toza suv yo'q. Aslida,
dunyodagi odamlarning yarmidan
ko'pi har kuni suv tanqisligi bilan
yashashga majbur. Hammamizga suv
kerak - faqat uylarimiz va
zavodlarimiz uchun emas, balki omon
qolish uchun. Baxtimizga, suvni
tejash uchun hammamiz qila oladigan
ishlar bor.

2) Yechim uydan boshlanadi. Biz
vannadagi suvni saqlab bog' uchun
ishlatishimiz mumkin - maysazor va
o'simliklarga yuzlab litr toza suvni
isrof qilish o'rniga. Bu har kuni,
ayniqsa yozda, ko'p litr suvni
tejashga yordam berardi.

3) Hukumatlar zavodlarning suvni
isrof qilishi va ifloslantirishini
to'xtatuvchi qonunlar qabul qilib
yordam bera oladi. Agar zavodlar
suvni qayta ishlasa va ko'l va
daryolarimizga kimyoviy moddalar
quyishni to'xtatsa, atrofda ancha
ko'proq toza suv bo'lardi.

4) Hukumatlar suv kompaniyalarining
oqayotgan quvurlar tufayli
millionlab litr suvni isrof
qilishini ham to'xtata olardi. Ko'p
shaharlar quvurlarni ta'mirlab
suvni muvaffaqiyatli tejagan.

5) Umuman olganda, sayyoramizning
yo'qolib borayotgan suv zaxiralarini
saqlash uchun qila oladigan ko'p
ishlarimiz bor. Toza suvsiz dunyo
dahshatli haqiqatga aylanishidan
oldin suvning qadrini tushunishni
boshlash vaqti keldi.


⚠ 'A SHORTAGE':

  = tanqislik, yetishmovchilik.
  ⚠ 'water shortages' = suv
  tanqisligi.
  ⚠ 'short' = qisqa, kam.


⚠ 'YET':

  = lekin, ammo (gap boshida).
  ⚠ Bu yerda 'hali' EMAS!


⚠ 'OVER HALF':

  = yarmidan ko'pi.
  ⚠ 'over' = ...dan ko'p.


⚠ 'FORTUNATELY':

  = baxtimizga.
  ⚠ 'unfortunately' = afsuski.


⚠ 'INSTEAD OF + -ING':

  = ... o'rniga.
  'instead of WASTING' - fe'l -ING
  bilan!


⚠ 'A LAWN':

  = maysazor.


⚠ 'A GOVERNMENT':

  = hukumat.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈɡʌvənmənt/ - birinchi
  'n' deyarli eshitilmaydi.


⚠ 'ALL IN ALL':

  = umuman olganda (xulosa).


⚠ 'THE TIME HAS COME':

  = vaqti keldi.


⚠ 'VALUE':

  = qadr, qiymat.


⚠ 'REALITY':

  = haqiqat, voqelik.
  ⚠ 'real' = haqiqiy.

tasks.en: Water, Water Everywhere ...
tasks.uz: Suv, hamma yerda suv ...

tasks.en: Imagine a world with no drinking water, and no water to wash or cook with. It's hard to imagine this, because we use water every day without even thinking about it.
tasks.uz: Ichimlik suvi bo'lmagan, yuvinish va ovqat pishirish uchun suv bo'lmagan dunyoni tasavvur qiling. Buni tasavvur qilish qiyin, chunki biz suvni har kuni hatto o'ylamasdan ishlatamiz.

tasks.en: Yet there are terrible water shortages all over the world. In parts of Africa and China, for example, many people don't even have clean water to drink.
tasks.uz: Lekin butun dunyoda dahshatli suv tanqisligi bor. Masalan, Afrika va Xitoyning ba'zi qismlarida ko'p odamlarda hatto ichish uchun toza suv yo'q.

tasks.en: In fact, over half of the people in the world have to live with water shortages every day. We all need water - not just for our homes and factories, but to survive. Fortunately, there are things that we can all do to save water.
tasks.uz: Aslida, dunyodagi odamlarning yarmidan ko'pi har kuni suv tanqisligi bilan yashashga majbur. Hammamizga suv kerak - faqat uylarimiz va zavodlarimiz uchun emas, balki omon qolish uchun. Baxtimizga, suvni tejash uchun hammamiz qila oladigan ishlar bor.

tasks.en: The solution begins at home. We can save the water from our baths and use it for the garden, instead of wasting hundreds of litres of clean water on our lawns and plants. This would help to save many litres of water everyday, especially in the summer.
tasks.uz: Yechim uydan boshlanadi. Biz vannadagi suvni saqlab bog' uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin - maysazor va o'simliklarga yuzlab litr toza suvni isrof qilish o'rniga. Bu har kuni, ayniqsa yozda, ko'p litr suvni tejashga yordam berardi.

tasks.en: Governments can help by passing laws to stop factories from wasting and polluting water. If factories recycled water and stopped pouring chemicals into our lakes and rivers, there would be a lot more clean water around.
tasks.uz: Hukumatlar zavodlarning suvni isrof qilishi va ifloslantirishini to'xtatuvchi qonunlar qabul qilib yordam bera oladi. Agar zavodlar suvni qayta ishlasa va ko'l va daryolarimizga kimyoviy moddalar quyishni to'xtatsa, atrofda ancha ko'proq toza suv bo'lardi.
tasks.note: ⚠ 2-tur shart gapi: 'If ... recycled ..., there would be'.

tasks.en: Governments could also stop water companies from wasting millions of litres of water because of leaking pipes. Many cities have successfully saved water by repairing pipes.
tasks.uz: Hukumatlar suv kompaniyalarining oqayotgan quvurlar tufayli millionlab litr suvni isrof qilishini ham to'xtata olardi. Ko'p shaharlar quvurlarni ta'mirlab suvni muvaffaqiyatli tejagan.

tasks.en: All in all, there are many things we can do to save our planet's disappearing water supplies. The time has come to start understanding the value of water, before a world without clean water becomes a terrible reality.
tasks.uz: Umuman olganda, sayyoramizning yo'qolib borayotgan suv zaxiralarini saqlash uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor. Toza suvsiz dunyo dahshatli haqiqatga aylanishidan oldin suvning qadrini tushunishni boshlash vaqti keldi.

2-TUR ShART GAPLARI - 11-UNITNING
ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF + PAST SIMPLE,
  WOULD/COULD/MIGHT + FE'L (to siz)

  'If I WERE the leader, I WOULD
   NOT ALLOW hunters ...'
  'If we USED bicycles, there
   WOULDN'T BE so much pollution.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  XAYoLIY yoki EhTIMOLDAN YIROQ
  vaziyat - HOZIR yoki KELAJAKDA.

  ⚠ 'If I were rich' - men boy
  EMASMAN (xayol).
  ⚠ Past simple bo'lsa ham O'TMISh
  haqida EMAS!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  1-TUR va 2-TUR FARQI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1-TUR (real):
     If it RAINS, I WILL stay home.
     (yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin)
  2-TUR (xayoliy):
     If it RAINED in the desert,
     plants WOULD grow.
     (cho'lda yomg'ir - ehtimoldan
      yiroq)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  'WERE' - HAMMA ShAXSDA          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'If I WERE you ...'
  'If he WERE rich ...'
  ⚠ 'was' ham to'g'ri (so'zlashuv),
  lekin 'were' rasmiy va odatiy.
  ⚠ 'If I were you, I would ...' =
  sening o'rningda bo'lsam - MASLAHAT
  qolipi!


⚠ 'BARE INFINITIVE':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv (fe'lning
  asosiy shakli).
  ⚠ 'would TO ban' - XATO!


⚠ QISQARTMALAR:

  I'd = I would; wouldn't = would
  not.

  "If we all USED bicycles, there

  2 If there WERE more bins in towns

    much litter on our streets.
  3 If we DIDN'T POLLUTE lakes and

  ⚠ 'recycling' = qayta ishlash.


⚠ 'WASTE':

  = chiqindi.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.

⚠ 'FEWER':

    c delfinni 'asrab olish'

  ko'proq a → 'yashil' emassiz!
  ko'proq b → harakat qilyapsiz,

  2-tur shart gaplari.

  = ...ga bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'TO STATE':

  = bayon qilmoq, aytmoq.


⚠ 'SEPARATE':

  = alohida. /ˈsepərət/ (sifat).


⚠ 'TO SUMMARISE':

  = umumlashtirmoq, xulosa qilmoq.
  ⚠ AmE 'summarize'.


⚠ 'NORMALLY':

  = odatda.

tasks.en: When we write an article suggesting solutions to problems we can divide it into five paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Muammolarga yechim taklif qiluvchi maqola yozganda uni besh xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph we state the problem.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida muammoni bayon qilamiz.

tasks.en: In the next paragraphs (2, 3 and 4) we write our suggested solutions to the problem. We write each suggestion with results/examples in a separate paragraph.
tasks.uz: Keyingi xatboshilarda (2, 3 va 4) muammoga taklif qilgan yechimlarimizni yozamiz. Har bir taklifni natija/misollari bilan alohida xatboshida yozamiz.

tasks.en: In the last paragraph we summarise our opinion.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida fikrimizni umumlashtiramiz.

tasks.en: We normally use present tenses and conditionals type 2 in such articles.
tasks.uz: Bunday maqolalarda odatda hozirgi zamonlar va 2-tur shart gaplarini ishlatamiz.

tasks.en: Our cities are becoming more and more polluted. There is rubbish everywhere, the air is dirty because of the traffic and there are very few green areas. What can we do to make our cities more environmentally friendly?
tasks.uz: Shaharlarimiz tobora ifloslanmoqda. Hamma yerda axlat, havo tirbandlik tufayli iflos va yashil hududlar juda kam. Shaharlarimizni atrof-muhitga do'stroq qilish uchun nima qila olamiz?

tasks.en: First of all, the authorities could put rubbish bins on every street corner. If they did this, people wouldn't drop litter in the streets and our cities would be much cleaner.
tasks.uz: Avvalo, hokimiyat har ko'cha burchagiga axlat qutisi qo'yishi mumkin. Agar shunday qilsa, odamlar ko'chaga axlat tashlamasdi va shaharlarimiz ancha toza bo'lardi.

tasks.en: Secondly, the authorities should improve public transport. If buses and trains were cheaper and faster, people would leave their cars at home and there would be less air pollution.
tasks.uz: Ikkinchidan, hokimiyat jamoat transportini yaxshilashi kerak. Agar avtobus va poyezdlar arzonroq va tezroq bo'lsa, odamlar mashinalarini uyda qoldirardi va havo ifloslanishi kamayardi.

tasks.en: Finally, we could create more parks and plant more trees. If there were more green areas, people would have more oxygen and children would be able to play safely.
tasks.uz: Nihoyat, ko'proq bog' yaratib, ko'proq daraxt ekishimiz mumkin. Agar ko'proq yashil hudud bo'lsa, odamlarda ko'proq kislorod bo'lardi va bolalar xavfsiz o'ynay olardi.

tasks.en: All in all, there are many things we can do to make our cities greener. If we all worked together, our cities would be cleaner, healthier and nicer places to live in.
tasks.uz: Umuman olganda, shaharlarimizni yashilroq qilish uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor. Agar hammamiz birga ishlasak, shaharlarimiz yashash uchun tozaroq, sog'lomroq va yoqimliroq joylar bo'lardi.

tasks.en:
Our cities are becoming more and more polluted. There is rubbish everywhere, the air is dirty because of the traffic and there are very few green areas. What can we do to make our cities more environmentally friendly?

First of all, the authorities could put rubbish bins on every street corner. If they did this, people wouldn't drop litter in the streets and our cities would be much cleaner.

Secondly, the authorities should improve public transport. If buses and trains were cheaper and faster, people would leave their cars at home and there would be less air pollution.

Finally, we could create more parks and plant more trees. If there were more green areas, people would have more oxygen and children would be able to play safely.

All in all, there are many things we can do to make our cities greener. If we all worked together, our cities would be cleaner, healthier and nicer places to live in.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences below. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
1) 'If every person swept their
   own doorstep, the city would
   soon be clean.'
   = Har kim o'z ostonasini supursa,
   shahar tez orada toza bo'lardi.
   MA'NOSI: har kim o'z ulushini
   qo'shsa, katta muammo hal bo'ladi.
   ⚠ 2-tur shart gapi!

2) 'It is never too late to mend.'
   = Tuzatish uchun hech qachon kech
   emas.
   MA'NOSI: xatoni tuzatishni istalgan
   vaqtda boshlash mumkin.


⚠ 'TO SWEEP':

  swept - swept. = supurmoq.


⚠ 'A DOORSTEP':

  = ostona (eshik oldi).


⚠ 'TO MEND':

  = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq.
  ⚠ 'mend your ways' = o'zini
  tuzatmoq.


⚠ 'THEIR OWN':

  'every person ... THEIR' - umumiy
  'his/her' o'rniga 'their'.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Muammo] is/are + 3-ShAKL by [sabab].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Endangered species are killed by hunters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xavf ostidagi turlar ovchilar tomonidan o'ldiriladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If we + PAST SIMPLE, we would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If we used bicycles, we would have less air pollution.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi kamroq bo'lardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I was leader of my country, I would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I was leader of my country, I would ban cars.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were leader of my country, I would / wouldn't + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were leader of my country, I would ban cars.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can hardly + FE'L because of [ot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can hardly breathe because of the traffic fumes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Transport tutuni tufayli deyarli nafas ololmayman.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] would stop [kim] from + -ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yog'och kompaniyalarini o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: One answer to the problem is to make [kim] + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: One answer to the problem is to make the logging companies plant new trees.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muammoning bir yechimi - yog'och kompaniyalarini yangi daraxt ekishga majburlash.

sentencePatterns.formula: If + ega + PAST SIMPLE, ega + would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If we all used bicycles, there wouldn't be so much air pollution.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar hammamiz velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi shunchalik ko'p bo'lmasdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were [kim], I would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were the leader of my country, I would ban cars.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar mamlakatim rahbari bo'lsam, mashinalarni taqiqlardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If there were [nima], there wouldn't be [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If there were more bins, there wouldn't be so much litter.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar ko'proq axlat qutisi bo'lsa, shunchalik ko'p axlat bo'lmasdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: When + PRESENT SIMPLE, will + FE'L. (real)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I am the leader of my country, I will ban cars.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mamlakatim rahbari bo'lganimda mashinalarni taqiqlayman.

sentencePatterns.formula: We can + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We can recycle water.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Suvni qayta ishlashimiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: ... instead of + -ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Use bath water for the garden instead of wasting clean water.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toza suvni isrof qilish o'rniga vanna suvini bog' uchun ishlating.

sentencePatterns.formula: ... by + -ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Many cities have saved water by repairing pipes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'p shaharlar quvurlarni ta'mirlab suvni tejagan.

sentencePatterns.formula: to stop [kim] from + -ING
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Laws stop factories from polluting water.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qonunlar zavodlarning suvni ifloslantirishini to'xtatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What would you do if you + PAST SIMPLE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What would you do if you had a computer?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar kompyuteringiz bo'lsa, nima qilardingiz?

sentencePatterns.formula: If I + PAST SIMPLE, I'd + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I found a spider in my bed, I'd scream.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar to'shagimda o'rgimchak topsam, qichqirardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: Would you + FE'L ...? (2-tur savol)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If you had £1,000, would you buy a fur coat?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar 1000 funtingiz bo'lsa, mo'yna palto sotib olarmidingiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'would you' - qisqa javob: Yes, I would. / No, I wouldn't.

sentencePatterns.formula: ZANJIR: If A, I would B. If I B-ed, I'd C.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I went to London, I'd visit Buckingham Palace. If I visited Buckingham Palace, I would meet the Queen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar Londonga borsam, Bukingem saroyiga borardim. Agar Bukingem saroyiga borsam, Qirolichani uchratardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were you, I would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I would try to eat fewer sweets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, kamroq shirinlik yeyishga harakat qilardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: You should / You could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should work fewer hours. You could start cycling to work.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kamroq soat ishlashing kerak. Ishga velosipedda yurishni boshlashing mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: If the authorities + PAST SIMPLE, people would(n't) + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If the authorities put bins on every corner, people wouldn't drop litter.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar hokimiyat har burchakka quti qo'ysa, odamlar axlat tashlamasdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can't stand + -ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can't stand driving in heavy traffic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tirbandlikda mashina haydashga toqat qila olmayman.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were you, I'd + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, shifokorga borardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If X + PAST SIMPLE, X would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If Bill won a million pounds, he would buy a helicopter.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar Bill million funt yutib olsa, vertolyot sotib olardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If X didn't + FE'L, Y wouldn't be + SIFAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If factories didn't pour chemicals into rivers, rivers wouldn't be polluted.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar fabrikalar daryolarga kimyoviy moddalar to'kmasa, daryolar ifloslanmasdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Type 0 / 1 / 2: present-present / present-will / past-would
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If you heat water, it boils. / If you take exercise, you'll be fitter. / If I had a car, I would use it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Suvni qizdirsangiz, qaynaydi. / Mashq qilsangiz, baquvvatroq bo'lasiz. / Mashinam bo'lsa, ishlatardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I lived in [joy], I would + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I lived in the village, I would have a peaceful life.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar qishloqda yashasam, osoyishta hayot kechirardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If X + PAST, we could + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If it weren't so cold, we could swim in the sea.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar shunchalik sovuq bo'lmasa, dengizda suzardik.

sentencePatterns.formula: Shall I ...? - No, if I were you, I'd ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Shall I get a rabbit? - No, if I were you, I'd get a cat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Quyon olaymi? - Yo'q, sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, mushuk olardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If we continue to + FE'L, X will + FE'L. (type 1)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If we continue to hunt endangered species, they will all die.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar xavf ostidagi turlarni ovlashda davom etsak, ularning hammasi o'ladi.
